visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young female creator with blonde hair in pigtails and a white ruffled top stands in a warmly lit indoor studio. She smiles brightly at the camera while holding a yellow character-themed pouch close to her face. In the background, a white espresso machine and various books are arranged on a shelf. (2) The scene cuts to the woman in a grey checkered shirt and a white headband. She winks playfully at the camera while holding a purple character card holder and showcasing a matching purple quilted handbag that features a 'Sweet Bean' charm hanging from the handle. (3) She switches back to her white ruffled top and demonstrates a yellow character acrylic charm. She points to the product with a joyful expression. The lighting is soft and flattering, highlighting her facial features and the vibrant colors of the merchandise. (4) Wearing a bright red cardigan over her white top, she holds several pastel-colored character charms. She then demonstrates how to attach a pink 'Sweet Bean' charm to a mahogany-colored leather handbag, showing the interaction between her hands and the product. (5) The woman showcases various card holders in purple, yellow, and cream. She turns the yellow one around to show the card slots on the back, demonstrating its practical use. She poses with a series of small character figurines, holding them up to the camera. (6) Final sequence features the creator drinking from a pink character-themed mug. A group shot displays the entire collection including mugs, figurines, and card holders on a table. She waves goodbye to the camera with a cheerful smile.
